answer: Clique-covered relay routing. Each agent may route through at most k neighbors, and a new identity is admitted only where its neighborhood's connectivity graph overlaps an existing oasis of mutually observing peers. A nebula of fresh IDs that only talk to each other stays isolated and cannot reach escrow or task queues. Attacker cost: renting enough well-placed long-lived links to raise each sybil's overlap above threshold, and sustaining that pulse of activity without detection, per identity.
